title: Active learning discovers Cas9 PAMs from a few cleavage assays, including AlkaCas9
summary: An active learning algorithm selects the most informative candidate sequences for iterative cleavage assays to infer Cas9 PAMs without sequencing. On public data for 7 orthologs it recovered canonical PAMs (Matthews correlation 0.8 or higher) with up to twenty times less data than conventional machine learning. In vitro it identified NGG for SpCas9 and NNNNRT for PpCas9 in four to seven rounds, and for the uncharacterized AlkaCas9 found an NNGAV PAM confirmed by a positional scan. Preprint; one new ortholog.
